infobox.title: धोखाधड़ी पहचान प्रणाली
infobox.imageCaption: Admin dashboard showing ML prediction analytics

lead:
The **Online Transaction धोखाधड़ी पहचान प्रणाली** is मेरे MCA Final Year Academic Project (3rd सेमेस्टर) — a full-stack banking fraud detection platform मैंने बनाया using **ASP.NET Web Forms** और a **4-algorithm ML ensemble**. Every transaction is classified by Logistic Regression, KNN, SVM, और a Convolutional Neural Network — if 3 or more algorithms vote fraudulent, the transaction is automatically blocked.

The सिस्टम includes real-time fraud detection, an intrusion detection module that tracks failed logins by IP और geolocation, SMTP email alerts, और a full admin panel के साथ Google Charts analytics. The code is publicly on [गिटहब](https://github.com/lingadevaru-hp/online-fraud-detection-system).

content.content:
I implemented all four ML एल्गोरिदम directly in C# rather than using a Python ML library. This was a deliberate constraint I set के लिए myself: the entire stack had to be a single ASP.NET application, not a Python microservice. It forced me to understand the mathematics of each algorithm rather than just calling sklearn.

मेरे **ensemble decision rule** is simple और interpretable: majority voting. If 3 or more of the 4 algorithms independently classify a transaction as fraudulent, the transaction is blocked. This reduces false positives compared to single-algorithm approaches while maintaining sensitivity.

rows.मैंने इसका उपयोग कैसे किया: Binary fraud/no-fraud classification on 4 normalised features
K=3 nearest neighbours in feature space
Support Vector Machine — finds maximum-margin decision boundary
Convolutional Neural Network — the only deep learning model in the ensemble

content.title: समूह निर्णय नियम
content.content: 3 or more out of 4 algorithms vote fraud → transaction blocked. This majority-voting approach is more robust than any single algorithm और reduces both false positives और false negatives compared to relying on the CNN alone.

rows.विवरण: Value of the transaction in rupees
Frequency of recent transactions from the account
0 = known safe location, 1 = flagged risky location
0 = business hours, 1 = odd hours (late night / early morning)

content.content:
**Fraud Detection:** Real-time ensemble ML voting on every transaction. Transaction blocked immediately when 3+ algorithms vote fraud — no human review queue.

**Intrusion Detection:** I track failed logins के साथ IP address, GPS geolocation, और timestamp. Auto account blocking triggers when 5+ failed transactions occur within 1 hour. SMTP email alerts are sent on suspicious activity.

**Admin Panel:** Full user management, bank CRUD operations, intrusion log viewer, transaction analytics के साथ Google Charts, और an ML prediction dashboard showing per-algorithm vote counts.

**User Side:** Supports creating bank accounts (SBI, HDFC, Karnataka Bank), adding wallet funds, transferring money के साथ live fraud detection, viewing account statements, और a per-account सुरक्षा key required के लिए all transactions.

content.title: मैंने लागू किए सुरक्षा उपाय
content.content: Parameterized SQL queries throughout (SQL injection prevention). Session management के साथ proper logout. Security key per bank account required के लिए all transaction operations.

sections.title: पायथन के बजाय C# क्यों चुना

content.content:
मेरे 3rd semester final year academic submission के लिए the MCA at SIT Tumakuru. The 4th (final) semester is reserved के लिए industry internship — this परियोजना was the 3rd semester deliverable.

I deliberately chose C# और ASP.NET rather than Python और Flask. C# और .NET represent a professional enterprise stack, और implementing ML एल्गोरिदम from scratch in a statically-typed language forced me to understand the underlying mathematics rather than just calling a Python library. It's a harder route that taught me more.

For contrast के साथ मेरे CHIAC ASI internship ML work (Python, QLoRA, transformer models), see [[thoshan-flash|Thoshan Flash]].
